ideas.pitch: A mobile web app enabling local panchayats to track and report village-level sanitation, clean water, and green energy metrics aligned with UN SDGs.
ideas.title: EcoGram: UN SDG Local Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the official hackathon theme of UN Sustainable Development Goals with a measurable impact dashboard, a pattern proven successful in winning civic tech hacks.

ideas.pitch: A fast mobile-first camera web app that scans product packaging barcodes or labels and instantly tells citizens how and where to recycle them locally.
ideas.title: BinScan: AI Recyclability Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with environmental sustainability, echoing past winning projects that focused on gamified or accessible recycling guidance.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined lightweight dashboard for rural bodies to monitor water purification unit statuses, pipeline leak reports, and community consumption.
ideas.title: JalSetu Lite: Community Water Asset Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural pattern of successful national rural infrastructure tracking tools while scaled down perfectly for an 8-hour build timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A route planner and community challenge app that incentivizes students and faculty to take low-emission public transport or carpool within college zones.
ideas.title: GreenPath: Carbon-Aware Campus Commute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to university sustainability goals with a functional walk-to-earn/commute-to-save mechanic that translates exceptionally well to live offline judging demos.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first progressive web app allowing local farmers to snap photos of crop leaves and receive instant disease diagnosis and organic remedy suggestions.
ideas.title: AgriGuard: Crop Disease Early Warning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses UN SDG Zero Hunger and Life on Land with a high-utility, working prototype that solves an immediate regional agricultural problem.
